post.summary: Indexes data for a specified repository.
post.description: This operation initializes or updates the index with the provided data. The `repositoryCode` path parameter identifies the repository to be indexed.

parameters.name: repositoryCode
parameters.description: A unique code that identifies the repository where data will be indexed

202.description: Accepted response indicating that the indexing operation has been queued for processing

post.summary: Indexes data for a specific organization within the given repository.
post.description: This operation targets organizational data within the repository for indexing. The `repositoryCode` identifies the repository, and the `organization` path parameter specifies the organization whose data will be indexed.

parameters.name: repositoryCode
parameters.description: A unique code that identifies the repository where data will be indexed

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization within the repository for which data will be indexed

202.description: Accepted response indicating that the indexing operation has been queued for processing

post.summary: Indexes data for a specific record identified by its ID within an organization in the given repository.
post.description: This operation allows fine-grained indexing at the record level. The `repositoryCode` identifies the repository, `organization` specifies the organization, and `id` refers to the unique identifier of the record to be indexed.

parameters.name: repositoryCode
parameters.description: A unique code that identifies the repository where data will be indexed

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the organization within the repository for which data will be indexed

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the record to be indexed within the specified organization.

202.description: Accepted response indicating that the indexing operation has been queued for processing

BadRequest.description: Error response indicating that the client's request is malformed or invalid

NotFound.description: Requested resource could not be found

UnauthorizedError.description: Access token is missing or invalid

ServiceUnavailableError.description: Unable to complete the request due to an issue with an external service.

successful.description: Indicates whether the indexing operation was successful or not

indexName.description: The name of the index where the data is stored.

successful.description: Indicates whether the indexing operation was successful or not
